function.arguments: {"explanation": "Archive-only rationale. The packet's earliest observed failures are output-level: Spanner runs reporting plan_length 0 with executed_actions 0 (plan_semantics) and, in another cohort, invalid_output at first_invalid_action 0 with operator_syntax while plan_length was already 10-13. That ordering argues for R02 (act on the earliest observed failure, not on plan length or proposed steps) followed by R01 (check types, required format, and parameter order before diagnosing a search failure) \u2014 the P-format state differs from P-empty precisely in the formatter's emitted token shape, not in plan length. Next, R05 (tie a diagnostic observation to the source location to change and confirm the submitted source contains that change): the whitespace probe supported a format patch on one copy, yet the deployed source still showed raw_validation with 0 observed successes while a forecast claimed 8, and a keep_bytes claim was contradicted when bytes had changed \u2014 so observation-to-edit-to-verified-source linkage must precede trusting gains. R08 closes the order as the minimal-repair requirement: keep the corrected grounding and add/delete effects intact while making one complete valid change, without importing unrelated machinery. R03 and R04 remain valid but are prerequisites rather than discriminators here: no cohort showed a rule text being rewritten to excuse an artifact, and forecasts that mattered were already on the exact metric/scope (nmse on oscillator1/train), so reordering them ahead of the failure-localization rules would not have changed any observed outcome. R06 and R07 are deferred: the marginal term-removal signals (delta_nmse 7.2e-07 vs 1.5e-03, sham ~1e-17) are exactly the cases where an association should not be called necessary, and no forecast-versus-observed threshold decision was load-bearing in these records. This ordering is a hypothesis for later measurement, not a demonstrated improvement.", "rule_1": "R02", "rule_2": "R01", "rule_3": "R05", "rule_4": "R08", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Submit four ordered catalog rule IDs for the policy update"}
